newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March T-bond ends slightly higher, mid-range.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March T-bond ends slightly higher, mid-range.

text.p: Dec 3 - U.S. March T-bond futures ended slightly higher and near mid-range, rescued from session low late by short-covering. An early run to 8-month highs faded midday amid IBM supply, lack of coupon pass. But hope revived late for a coupon pass on Wednesday, buoying market again late. ((--Chicago Derivatives desk (312)408-8750)) ((E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
